title: Project Accounting Standards: Contract Deposit Amount and Net Price on Replacement System Installations
content:
# Contract deposit amount

## Standard

The contract deposit on a Replacement System Installations project is the higher of the package's smallest deposit and the package's deposit percentage of the contract's net price, which is the contract-price charge plus every accessory charge, less every member install credit, accessory member discount, manufacturer rebate and multi-system discount posted on the project, rounded to the cent half up.

The package's deposit percentage and smallest deposit are the payment-terms figures of the project's package.

## The net price

| Enters the net price | Direction |
|---|---|
| Contract-price charge | Added |
| Every accessory charge | Added |
| Every member install credit posted on the project | Taken off |
| Every accessory member discount posted on the project | Taken off |
| Every manufacturer rebate posted on the project | Taken off |
| Every multi-system discount posted on the project | Taken off |

Permit-fee charges, change-order charges, labor-warranty upgrade charges and payments do not enter the net price.

## Order of the computation

1. The deposit rate is applied to the net price.
2. That amount is multiplied by its multiplier (a multiplier of 1 leaves it unchanged) and rounded to the cent half up.
3. The higher of that rounded amount and the package's smallest deposit is taken.
4. Amounts collected with the deposit, each rounded to the cent half up on its own, are then added.

## Worked example (hypothetical project)

A hypothetical Harbison Performance Series System project (deposit percentage 15 percent, smallest deposit $500.00) carries a $12695.00 contract-price charge and a $295.00 accessory charge, with a $250.00 member install credit and a $29.50 accessory member discount posted.

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Net price: $12695.00 plus $295.00 less $250.00 less $29.50 | $12710.50 |
| 15 percent of the net price | $1906.575 |
| Rounded to the cent half up | $1906.58 |
| Higher of $1906.58 and $500.00 | $1906.58 |

## Minimum in play (hypothetical project)

On a hypothetical net price of $3000.00 at 10 percent, the percentage deposit is $300.00; the higher of $300.00 and $500.00 is $500.00.
